nodes.title: Damask Rose Cold Processed Soap
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Infused with saponified extra Virgin- coconut oil, this handmade soap deeply cleanses while maintaining natural skin moisture, making it suitable for all skin types including sensitive skin.
  • French pink clay gently detoxifies and exfoliates, removing dead skin cells and impurities while leaving your skin soft, radiant, and visibly smoother after regular use.
  • Enriched with Rose Centifolia absolute oil, known for its calming fragrance and skin-conditioning properties, offering a spa-like floral experience during every bath or shower.
  • Vitamin E supports skin repair and reduces signs of aging by providing antioxidant protection and aiding skin elasticity, helping you maintain youthful, nourished skin.
  • The inclusion of Aqua and Damask Rose provides hydration and a luxurious feel, creating a lather that refreshes and uplifts, leaving a subtle rose scent on your skin all day.

nodes.title: Oriental Lavendar Cold Processed Soap
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Crafted with saponified extra Virgin- coconut oil, this luxurious soap gently cleanses while locking in moisture, making it perfect for dry, sensitive, and normal skin types.
  • Infused with alkanet root extract, known for its natural coloring and soothing properties, it helps calm inflammation and promotes a clearer, healthier-looking complexion.
  • Enriched with pure Lavandula Angustifolia (lavender) oil, offering stress-relief, gentle skin nourishment, and a soft, relaxing aroma that lingers after every bath.
  • Vitamin E acts as a powerful antioxidant, fighting free radicals, improving skin tone, and helping your skin stay soft, youthful, and revitalized with regular use.
  • Oriental lavender scent combined with Aqua delivers deep hydration and a calming aromatherapy experience, creating a refreshing and luxurious lather every time you bathe.

nodes.title: Camphora Pink Salt Cold Processed Soap
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Formulated with saponified extra Virgin- coconut oil, this soap deeply cleanses and nourishes while maintaining the skin’s natural barrier and hydration level for daily freshness.
  • Infused with Cinnamomum Camphora (camphor) oil, known for its cooling, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties to soothe irritated skin and refresh tired senses.
  • Kaolin clay gently exfoliates and draws out impurities from deep within pores, improving skin clarity, refining texture, and promoting a soft, radiant glow.
  • Vitamin E supports skin cell regeneration and provides antioxidant defense, helping to reduce signs of damage, dryness, and dullness with regular use.
  • The combination of Aqua and pink salt revitalizes skin while promoting a spa-like detoxifying experience that leaves the skin clean, cool, and naturally balanced.

nodes.title: Tea Tree Cold processed Soap
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Enriched with French green clay to gently exfoliate, detoxify pores, and remove impurities, this soap bar supports clearer, smoother skin without irritation or dryness.
  • Saponified extra virgin coconut oil and olive oil form a nourishing base that delivers deep hydration while maintaining the skin’s natural moisture barrier for a soft, supple feel.
  • Powered by melaleuca alternifolia (tea tree) oil, known for its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, this bar helps combat acne, redness, and blemishes effectively.
  • Naturally packed with Vitamin E to support skin repair, boost elasticity, and provide antioxidant protection, leaving skin revitalized and shielded against environmental damage.
  • Free from harsh detergents, artificial fragrances, and parabens, this soap is handmade with pure ingredients for a clean, plant-based skincare experience ideal for all skin types.

nodes.title: Orange Tangerine Cold Processed Soap
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Infused with herb Annato, this bar cleanses deeply while leaving skin soft and nourished; ideal for dry, sensitive, or acne-prone skin types needing gentle purification. 
  • Saponified extra virgin coconut oil creates a rich, creamy lather that lifts away dirt without stripping your skin’s natural moisture, making it suitable for daily use on face and body.
  • Refreshing Sweet Bitter Orange  oil delivers a refreshing citrus aroma while promoting skin clarity and balancing oil production—perfect for morning routines and oily or blemish-prone skin.
  • Naturally rich in Vitamin E, this bar provides antioxidant benefits that help fight environmental damage and support a youthful glow, encouraging skin repair and regeneration.
  • Made without synthetic additives or harsh chemicals, this soap is crafted with pure, plant-based ingredients, ensuring a clean, eco-conscious skincare choice for all skin types.

nodes.title: Coffee Vanilla Cold Processed Soap
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Energizing arabica coffee gently exfoliates dead skin while stimulating circulation, leaving skin smooth, refreshed, and visibly brighter after every use—ideal for dull or tired skin.
  • Saponified coconut and olive oils provide a rich, moisturizing lather that cleanses deeply without drying, making this bar suitable for everyday body and face care.
  • Chocolate clay helps draw out impurities and improves skin texture while adding a silky feel to the lather, perfect for refining pores and softening the skin naturally.
  • Infused with vanilla oleoresin for a warm, comforting aroma that soothes the senses while supporting skin hydration and elasticity with every gentle cleanse.
  • Fortified with Vitamin E, this bar helps protect against environmental stressors while promoting skin healing and renewal—crafted without parabens or artificial additives.

nodes.title: Himalayan Jasmine Cold Processed Soap
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Infused with Jasminum Grandiflorum, this bar offers a delicate floral aroma that soothes the senses while enhancing skin tone and delivering a luxurious cleansing experience.
  • Saponified coconut and olive oils create a soft, creamy lather that moisturizes and purifies the skin without stripping away its natural oils—perfect for everyday use.
  • Kaolin clay gently draws out impurities, refines skin texture, and soothes irritation, making this bar ideal for sensitive, dry, or combination skin needing a calm, clean finish.
  • Rich in Vitamin E, the formula supports skin repair and protects against environmental stressors while helping maintain elasticity and a radiant, healthy-looking glow.
  • Free from synthetic fragrances, sulfates, and parabens, this handcrafted soap is made with clean, natural ingredients for a mindful and skin-safe skincare routine

nodes.title: Charcoal Mint Cold Processed Soap
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Activated bamboo charcoal deeply cleanses pores, removes toxins, and reduces acne, making this bar perfect for oily, acne-prone, and combination skin seeking a detoxifying cleanse.
  • Saponified extra virgin coconut and olive oils form a gentle yet nourishing base that hydrates while cleansing, leaving skin soft, clean, and refreshed after every use.
  • Infused with Mentha Piperita (peppermint) oil, this bar offers a cooling sensation and invigorating scent that helps awaken your senses and soothe inflamed or irritated skin.
  • Vitamin E adds essential antioxidant protection, supporting cell renewal and promoting a healthier, more radiant complexion with regular use—suitable for face and body.
  • Handcrafted without sulfates, parabens, or synthetic fragrances, this soap offers a clean, eco-conscious skincare choice designed for performance and purity.

nodes.title: Red Sandalwood Cold Processed Soap
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Rhassoul clay gently exfoliates, detoxifies, and improves skin clarity by drawing out deep-seated impurities—ideal for dull, oily, or congested skin seeking balance and radiance.
  • Saponified coconut and olive oils create a creamy, hydrating lather that cleanses without over-drying, keeping your skin soft, nourished, and balanced with every use.
  • Santalum album L (red sandalwood) oil delivers a calming, woody aroma while supporting skin tone, soothing inflammation, and enhancing overall skin texture naturally.
  • Fortified with Vitamin E, this bar helps protect against environmental damage, encourages skin renewal, and promotes a more youthful, glowing complexion over time.
  • Free from synthetic fragrances, parabens, and sulfates, this bar is handmade with pure, plant-based ingredients for a clean and conscious skincare routine for all skin types.

nodes.title: Neem Basil Cold Processed Soap
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Neem oil and turmeric work together to calm inflammation, fight acne-causing bacteria, and promote clearer, healthier skin—perfect for blemish-prone or oily skin types.
  • Saponified extra virgin coconut oil provides a creamy, nourishing base that deeply cleanses while locking in moisture—leaving skin soft, refreshed, and never stripped.
  • Kaolin clay gently detoxifies and soothes the skin by drawing out excess oil and impurities without irritation, making it ideal for daily use on sensitive or reactive skin.
  • Ocimum basilicum (basil) oil adds a clarifying boost with natural antibacterial properties and a fresh herbal aroma that calms the senses and refreshes the skin.
  • Infused with Vitamin E to support skin repair, protect against environmental stress, and promote a naturally radiant complexion—free from parabens, sulfates, and synthetic additives.

nodes.title: Floral Soap Gift Set
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• This luxury gift set includes three uniquely blended soaps: Orange Tangerine, Oriental Lavender, and Tea Tree, offering a complete sensory experience with every shower or bath.
  • The invigorating Orange Tangerine soap revitalizes and refreshes the skin, leaving behind a citrusy aroma that energizes the body and mind—perfect for morning routines or dull skin.
  • Oriental Lavender soap provides a calming, soothing floral fragrance while nourishing the skin with moisturizing oils, ideal for unwinding after a long day or a relaxing soak.
  • Tea Tree soap offers a deep-cleansing experience, balancing oily skin and offering natural antibacterial properties that leave skin feeling fresh, clear, and revitalized.
  • Each soap is carefully handcrafted with pure ingredients like coconut, olive, and essential oils, offering a sulfate-free, paraben-free, and eco-conscious skincare experience.

nodes.title: Wellness Trio Soap Bundle
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• This Wellness Trio Soap Bundle includes three invigorating soaps: Charcoal Mint, Tea Tree, and Camphora Pink Salt—perfect for detoxifying, purifying, and refreshing your skin with every use.
  • Charcoal Mint Soap detoxifies and exfoliates, drawing out impurities from deep within the skin while leaving behind a refreshing minty scent—perfect for oily or blemish-prone skin.
  • Tea Tree Soap harnesses the natural antibacterial power of tea tree oil to help combat acne, balance oily skin, and keep your complexion clear, smooth, and refreshed.
  • Camphora Pink Salt Soap is enriched with pink Himalayan salt and camphora, offering gentle exfoliation and detoxification while soothing tired muscles and calming the skin.
  • Handcrafted with natural, nourishing ingredients like coconut and olive oils, these soaps are free from sulfates, parabens, and synthetic fragrances for a truly clean, skin-safe experience.

nodes.title: Facial Ubtan - Orange Almond
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Organic Mamra Almonds provide natural exfoliation and nourishment, helping to brighten, soften, and rejuvenate the skin for a healthy, glowing complexion with each use.
  • Brazilian Orange essential oil adds a fresh citrusy scent while revitalizing the skin, promoting collagen production, and leaving skin smooth, vibrant, and visibly radiant.
  • Saffron brightens dark spots and hyperpigmentation, while offering antioxidant-rich benefits that help even skin tone and promote a healthy, youthful glow.
  • Organic Red Lentils gently cleanse and exfoliate, removing dead skin cells while boosting circulation, leaving your face feeling fresh, revitalized, and balanced.
  • Free from artificial fragrances, parabens, and sulfates, this facial ubtan is made with pure, organic ingredients that are safe and nourishing for all skin types, especially sensitive skin.

nodes.title: Body Ubtan - Tea Tree
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• Colloidal Oats soothe and calm irritated skin, offering deep hydration and relief for dry, itchy, or sensitive skin, making this ubtan perfect for post-shower care or skin flare-ups.
  • Tea Tree Oil provides natural antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, helping to detoxify and cleanse the skin, while reducing acne, redness, and skin inflammation.
  • Green Clay absorbs excess oil and impurities from the skin’s surface, refining pores, detoxifying, and leaving the skin feeling fresh, smooth, and revitalized after every use.
  • Neem deeply nourishes and supports the skin's natural healing process, promoting a clearer complexion while combating acne-causing bacteria, making it ideal for blemish-prone skin.
  • Free from sulfates, parabens, and synthetic fragrances, this body ubtan uses pure, plant-based ingredients to gently exfoliate, hydrate, and restore the skin to its natural glow.

nodes.title: Almond Facial Oil
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• 100% Cold-Pressed Almond Seed Oil is rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and essential fatty acids that nourish, hydrate, and rejuvenate your skin for a youthful, glowing complexion.
  • This luxurious Almond facial oil deeply penetrates the skin, improving elasticity and helping to reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, and age spots for smoother, firmer skin.
  • Packed with vitamin C and vitamin A, Almond oil promotes collagen production, helps brighten dark spots, and supports even skin tone, leaving your face radiant and refreshed.
  • Lightweight and non-greasy, this facial oil absorbs quickly, delivering moisture without clogging pores—making it ideal for all skin types, including oily and acne-prone skin.
  • Free from parabens, sulfates, and synthetic fragrances, this pure Almond oil is perfect for those seeking a natural, chemical-free skincare solution that delivers visible, long-lasting results.

nodes.title: Triple Body Butter -Rose
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• DYU Triple Body Butter - Rose blends cocoa, mango, and shea butter with coconut oil and rose absolute to deliver deep, lasting hydration while leaving skin soft, smooth, and beautifully scented.
  • Infused with Rose Centifolia Absolute, this body butter soothes the senses with a gentle floral aroma while helping calm inflammation and restore the skin's natural glow and suppleness.
  • Cocoa and mango butter work together to nourish dry, rough skin and provide a rich, creamy texture that melts on contact and absorbs easily without feeling greasy or sticky.
  • Shea butter and coconut oil offer intense moisturization, protecting against dryness, improving elasticity, and helping to repair damaged skin from environmental stressors and pollutants.
  • Enriched with vitamin E, this chemical-free body moisturiser promotes skin repair and rejuvenation, making it perfect for daily use on dry areas like elbows, knees, hands, and feet.

nodes.title: Triple Body Butter -Lavendar
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• DYU Triple Body Butter - Lavender blends rich cocoa, mango, and shea butters with coconut oil and lavender essential oil to intensely moisturize and soothe dry, tired, or irritated skin.
  • Calming Lavandula Angustifolia essential oil provides a gentle floral scent that promotes relaxation, relieves skin redness, and helps restore balance to sensitive or inflamed skin.
  • The creamy blend of mango and cocoa butter delivers long-lasting hydration and skin-softening benefits, perfect for daily use to heal dry patches and promote silky-smooth texture.
  • Shea butter and coconut oil protect against environmental stress while deeply nourishing the skin barrier, making this body butter ideal for dry climates or post-shower skin repair. 
  • Fortified with antioxidant-rich vitamin E, this chemical-free, fast-absorbing formula enhances skin elasticity, reduces flakiness, and leaves a soft, radiant glow without greasiness.

nodes.title: Triple Body Butter -Sandalwood
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• DYU Triple Body Butter ? Sandalwood offers intense hydration with cocoa, mango, and shea butters blended with coconut oil and sandalwood for deeply nourished, soft, and supple skin.
  • Infused with Santalum album L (pure sandalwood), this body butter calms the skin and uplifts the senses with a warm, woody aroma that lingers and comforts without overpowering.
  • The rich formula melts on contact and absorbs quickly, locking in moisture while healing dryness, rough patches, and improving overall skin tone and texture with daily application.
  • Coconut oil and shea butter work together to restore the skin barrier, soothe irritation, and shield the skin from pollutants, making this ideal for sensitive and mature skin types.
  • With added vitamin E for antioxidant support, this non-toxic, paraben-free body butter promotes cell regeneration and keeps your skin radiant, firm, and silky smooth all day long.

nodes.title: Lavendar Haze Soap Bar -60 gm
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Calm your senses and indulge your skin with our Lavender Honeycomb Soap, a handcrafted cold process soap bar made with pure coconut oil and naturally colored with alkanet root. Its signature honeycomb design makes it as beautiful as it is nourishing.

Infused with lavender essential oil, this natural soap gently cleanses while leaving your skin soft, hydrated, and lightly scented with calming floral notes. The coconut oil base creates a rich, creamy lather that locks in moisture, making it an ideal daily soap for dry, sensitive, or delicate skin.

✔ Natural & Handmade – Cold process soap made in small batches
✔ Moisturizing Coconut Oil Base – Gentle on dry and sensitive skin
✔ Soothing Lavender Aroma – Perfect for relaxation and stress relief
✔ Naturally Tinted with Alkanet – Earthy tones without synthetic dyes
✔ Travel-Friendly 60g Size – Great for gifting or everyday use

Skin Type: Suitable for all skin types, especially dry & sensitive skin.
Best For: Daily bathing, gifting, travel kits, and self-care rituals.

nodes.descriptionHtml:

nodes.title: Tea Tree Trip Soap Bar
nodes.descriptionHtml:

nodes.title: Mud Face Wash
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• With Premium Bentonite Clay: Draws out impurities, deeply detoxifies pores, and balances oil without drying your skin — a superior alternative to Multani Mitti.
  • 🌾 Gram Flour for Gentle Exfoliation: A time-honoured Indian beauty grain that buffs away dead skin, smoothens texture, and evens out your tone.
  • ✨ Turmeric & Mint Combo: Turmeric reduces bacteria, acne, and tan while mint cools and refreshes, leaving you with calm, glowing skin.
  • 🌞 Ideal for All Skin Types: Whether dry, oily, or sensitive — this ubtan face wash adapts to your skin’s rhythm and revives its glow.
  • 🌿 100% Natural & Handmade: No chemicals, parabens, or sulfates. Crafted in small batches with love and plant-based ingredients.

nodes.title: Rosemary Olive Hair Oil
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• 100 % Pure Luxury Cold Pressed Olive Oil: The highest grade, nutrient-rich olive oil—never diluted or blended—retaining maximum vitamins and polyphenols for intense hydration and hair strength.
  • Infused with Fresh Rosemary Essence: Infusion stimulates follicles for visible hair growth and natural thickness; combats dandruff and soothes irritation, reviving scalp vitality. 
  • Ayurvedic & Chemical-Free Purity: Handcrafted, free from artificial additives, parabens, or mineral oils—ensuring a clean, gentle experience for delicate scalps and baby skin. 
  • Versatile Beauty Ritual: Use as a premium hair oil, a luxurious body or baby massage blend, or as an intensive hair mask for instant radiance and manageability.
  • Promotes Shine, Strength, and Growth: Olive oil’s emollient and restorative properties power deep repair, smooth cuticles, tame frizz, and bring unparalleled shine to every strand.

nodes.title: Cold Pressed Sweet Almond Oil
nodes.descriptionHtml:
• 100 % Pure & Cold Pressed – Extracted from high-quality almond seeds using traditional cold-press methods to retain nutrients and potency. Free from parabens, sulfates, mineral oil, and artificial fragrances. 
  •  Lightweight & Non-Greasy Facial Oil – Absorbs quickly without clogging pores, making it ideal for all skin types—including oily, acne-prone, or sensitive skin.

  • Nourishes & Brightens Skin – Rich in vitamins A, C, E this sweet almond oil deeply hydrates, improves elasticity, and helps reduce dark spots, dullness, and early signs of ageing. 
  •  Promotes Hair Growth & Scalp Health – Strengthens hair from root to tip, reduces breakage, and adds natural shine. Gently massage into scalp or blend with your favourite carrier oils for strong, healthy hair.

  •  Multi-Purpose – A time-tested, natural oil for baby massage and softening delicate skin. Also great for nails, elbows, lips, and DIY skincare blends. A bottle of goodness for the whole family.

nodes.descriptionHtml:
